description:
You are a Plant Quality Director at a consumer electronics OEM coordinating a critical field failure response in Odoo 17 (http://localhost:8069, login: admin / admin). A mounting bracket fracture has been reported in field-deployed Acoustic Bloc Screens. Execute the full quality response:

1. Create a quality alert titled "Field Failure - Acoustic Bloc Screen Mounting Bracket Fracture" for product "Acoustic Bloc Screens", set priority to Urgent, and enter this description: "Multiple field returns reporting mounting bracket fracture at the wall-mount interface. Failure mode: fatigue crack initiation at stress concentration in bracket fillet radius. 14 units returned from 3 distribution channels over 45-day period. Risk classification: Safety-Critical per company procedure QP-RISK-001."
2. In that alert's Corrective Action, enter: "Immediate: Stop shipment on all current inventory containing affected bracket design. Notify distributors to halt sales per procedure QP-REC-001. Conduct fractographic analysis on 10 returned units at metallurgy lab. Root cause confirmed: fatigue crack initiation at stress concentration in bracket radius R=1.2mm, below minimum design requirement of R=3mm."
3. In that alert's Preventive Action, enter: "Long-term: Redesign bracket with increased fillet radius R greater than or equal to 3mm per FEA analysis FEA-2024-0291. Update engineering drawing DWG-AB-0044 Rev C. Implement 100% incoming ultrasonic inspection for bracket castings per ASTM E164. Add bracket dimensional check to receiving inspection QCP."
4. Create a Quality Control Point titled "Bracket Integrity - Acoustic Bloc Screens" for product "Acoustic Bloc Screens", Operation Type set to Receipts, Control Type set to Pass - Fail, and set its Failure Message to: "CRITICAL REJECT: Bracket shows UT indication per ASTM E164. Segregate unit immediately. Notify QA Director per escalation procedure ESP-QA-003. Do not release to production."
5. Find the existing quality alert "Screen Frame Scratch on Delivery" and move it from the New stage to the In Progress stage.
6. Find the existing quality check "Screen Colour Uniformity Audit" (currently in To Do state) and mark it as Passed.
7. Create a new quality check titled "Bracket UT Inspection - Acoustic Bloc Screens" for product "Acoustic Bloc Screens" in the To Do state.
